description: Retrieve claim timeline for a flight date. Use when needing specific deadlines and evidence for EU261 or UK261 claims. Do NOT use for general disruption rights; use disruption_rights instead.
name: claim_timeline

claim_deadline.description: The deadline by which the claim must be submitted, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

evidence_checklist.description: A list of required evidence for the claim.

items.description: A specific piece of evidence required for the claim.

flight_date.description: The date of the flight in YYYY-MM-DD format.

scheme.description: The scheme under which the claim is being made, either EU261 or UK261.

title: Claim timeline
